task_title: Gate Copilot issue-assignment on blocked_by + auto-assign unblocked dependents

plan_review.summary: Rubber-duck (gpt-5.4, high effort) reviewed the blocked_by gate + auto-unblock-sweep design (wrapper functions around runIssueIntake vs. gating inside runIssueIntake directly). Verdict: approved_with_changes. Affirmed the wrapper approach (intakeOpenedIssue/intakeUnblockedDependents) over gating inside runIssueIntake, since the closed-issue sweep needs per-dependent branching and error isolation that a single gated function cannot provide. Raised two non-blocking concerns: (1) kickoff-comment idempotency is read-then-write, not atomic, under concurrent unblock sweeps; (2) unblock path trusted a stale snapshot state/repository.full_name from the blocking payload without a final liveness check before assignment. Concern 2 was addressed by adding a live issueState===OPEN guard inside runIssueIntake (throws IssueNoLongerOpenError otherwise). Concern 1 (comment double-post race) was accepted as a known, low-probability, non-data-corrupting risk -- documented in the handoff -- since GitHub issue comment posting has no compare-and-swap primitive to make it atomic without introducing a separate lock resource.

rounds.summary: 3 findings: (1-medium) getBlockedByDependencies/getBlockingDependents silently coerced non-array API responses to [], violating the fail-loud contract; (2-low) the race-condition throw from runIssueIntake when an issue closed mid-sweep was recorded as an error (process.exitCode=1) instead of a benign skip; (3-low) both dependency fetches used a single request() call with per_page=100, silently truncating >100-entry dependency lists. All 3 fixed: switched both fetchers to delegate to the existing paginate() helper (fail-loud + full pagination in one change), and introduced an exported IssueNoLongerOpenError class so intakeUnblockedDependents can special-case the race as {assigned:false,reason} instead of {error}.

Independent fresh pass confirmed all 3 round-1 fixes correctly implemented and wired (paginate imported/threaded through both library functions and all call sites, test mocks updated to mock paginate(token,path) instead of request). No new issues found across correctness, security, determinism, wiring, and regression-coverage categories.
